rationale: KYMR has gapped up ~6.7% on 10x relative volume following what appears to be a catalyst event, but price is now sitting at 37.9% of today's range after pulling back significantly from the $180 high, trading below VWAP ($171.02) and near the 9-EMA ($167.46). The wide bid-ask spread (42.3 bps) and the large intraday range ($160.49–$180.00) create unfavorable risk/reward for both directions: a long faces overhead supply and VWAP resistance with no clear base, while a short risks a resumption of the gap-driven momentum. The current price action shows choppy, low-conviction 1-minute candles with no directional edge to exploit cleanly.
